message.name: DYT_GIMBAL_TELEMETRY
message.description: DYT periodic gimbal telemetry. Values match bytes 2-30 of the DYT serial telemetry frame; the serial sync and checksum are not carried in MAVLink.
message.field: Target offset X in 0.05 degree units.
Target offset Y in 0.05 degree units.
Roll frame angle in 0.01 degree units.
Pitch frame angle in 0.01 degree units.
Yaw frame angle in 0.01 degree units.
DYT serial frame bytes 16-17.
DYT serial frame bytes 18-19.
Roll angular rate in 0.01 degree/s units.
Pitch angular rate in 0.01 degree/s units.
Yaw angular rate in 0.01 degree/s units.
Laser distance in 0.1 metre units; zero means invalid.
DYT serial frame bytes 29-30.
DYT serial frame byte 2.
DYT serial frame byte 3.
DYT serial frame byte 4, low eight bits of zoom in 0.1x units.
DYT serial frame byte 5; low nibble is high four bits of zoom.
DYT serial frame byte 28.

message.name: DYT_TRACKING_COMMAND
message.description: Set DYT tracking on or off. The receiver responds with DYT_TRACKING_ACK using the same sequence and enabled fields.
message.field: Command sequence number, wrapped modulo 65536.
Target MAVLink system.
Target MAVLink component; zero addresses the whole system.
One starts tracking; zero stops tracking.

message.name: DYT_TRACKING_ACK
message.description: Application-level result of a DYT tracking command.
message.field: Sequence number from DYT_TRACKING_COMMAND.
MAVLink system that sent the command; zero for broadcast.
MAVLink component that sent the command; zero for broadcast.
Requested tracking state from DYT_TRACKING_COMMAND.
Zero accepted, one denied, two failed, three unsupported.
